description:
Core technical skills that are highly useful
Data science / geospatial analysis — Working with NASA datasets (SMAP soil moisture, GPM/IMERG precipitation, Landsat & MODIS vegetation indices, ECOSTRESS, NASA POWER, GRACE, SRTM elevation, etc.). Experience with time-series analysis, vegetation indices (NDVI and related), soil-moisture/temperature trends, and climate indicators is especially valuable.
Python (or R) for data processing — Libraries such as xarray, rasterio, geopandas, rioxarray.
